topic_ko: 동물 의식에 대한 인간 배타성 믿음을 버릴 때
_note: 함축(논설문) FULL set. 유형마다 passage를 다르게 paraphrase. grammar/vocab의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재. implication의 underlined도 동일.

passage: In fact, scientists attributing consciousness to any animal is so recent that the internet is older.
In 1976 a zoologist named Donald Griffin argued that animal cognition deserved serious scientific attention.
Having spent a lifetime watching bats, he became convinced that they possessed genuine inner lives.
Their flexible behavior — the capacity to adapt as circumstances shifted — was, he maintained, a hallmark of true intelligence.
He'd observed bats devise resourceful strategies for locating food and exhibit problem-solving skills comparable to our own.
Despite the remarkable progress of neuroscience, no one had yet identified a brain region unique to humans that could account for consciousness.
Animal thought and reason, Griffin insisted, warranted rigorous study.
Wasn't it time to give up the ghost?
choices: the long-held belief that consciousness belongs exclusively to humans
the rapid growth of neuroscience research and its funding priorities
the assumption that bats lack genuine problem-solving abilities
the tradition of treating animals as spiritual beings in scientific inquiry
the legal framework that reserves consciousness rights for humans alone
implication.explanation_ko: 'the ghost'는 버려야 할 대상으로, 본문 전체 논거(박쥐의 지능·신경과학의 미발견)가 도전하는 '의식은 인간에게만 고유하다는 오래된 믿음'을 가리킨다. ①이 그 함축 의미와 정확히 일치한다.
implication.distractor_ko: ②신경과학 연구 자금 성장은 본문에 없다. ③박쥐의 지능 결여 가정은 글의 전제이지 ghost의 지시 대상이 아니다. ④동물의 영적 존재 취급 전통은 비유 맥락과 다르다. ⑤법적 권리 체계는 본문 범위 밖이다.

passage: Scientific acceptance that animals possess consciousness is surprisingly modern — even younger than the internet.
Donald Griffin, a zoologist who had earlier confirmed that bats navigate by echolocation, devoted his career to arguing for animal cognition.
After years of field observation, he concluded that bats displayed flexible, intelligent behavior.
They could adapt their strategies as conditions changed and demonstrated creative problem-solving on a par with humans.
Griffin urged the scientific community to study animal thought and reason seriously.
Meanwhile, neuroscience had failed to locate any part of the human brain exclusively responsible for consciousness.
This absence of evidence weakened the assumption that consciousness is a uniquely human trait.
In short, Griffin asked whether the scientific world was ready to abandon that assumption.
choices: the evolutionary origins of bat echolocation and navigation
the scientific case for reconsidering consciousness as a trait shared beyond humans
why neuroscience has struggled to map the human brain accurately
how field observation methods transformed modern zoology
the legal and ethical debate over animal rights in the twenty-first century
theme.explanation_ko: Griffin의 박쥐 연구와 신경과학의 미발견을 통해 '의식이 인간 배타적'이라는 가정을 재고해야 한다는 내용. ②가 주제다.
theme.distractor_ko: ①박쥐 반향정위는 배경이고, ③신경과학의 한계는 보조 논거이며, ④현장 관찰 방법론·⑤동물권 법·윤리는 본문에 없다.

passage: The idea that animals might be conscious is surprisingly new — more recent than the internet itself.
Griffin's observations of bats revealed adaptive intelligence: they changed strategies, solved problems, and made real-time decisions.
These abilities closely mirrored problem-solving capacities found in humans.
Neuroscience, for all its advances, had not pinpointed any brain structure unique to humans that explained consciousness.
The assumption that consciousness is exclusively human therefore lacked neurological support.
Griffin believed animal thought and reason must be rigorously examined by science.
The time had come to let go of the notion that inner awareness belongs only to us.
Consciousness, in other words, may not be humanity's private domain.
choices: 박쥐의 반향정위 능력은 오랜 진화의 산물이다.
동물 인지를 연구하는 것은 신경과학의 최우선 과제이다.
의식은 인간에게만 고유한 자질이 아닐 수 있으며, 이 믿음을 버려야 한다.
과학 기술의 발전이 동물의 행동 연구를 근본적으로 변화시켰다.
인간 뇌의 고유 구조가 밝혀지면 동물 의식 논쟁은 해결될 것이다.
gist.explanation_ko: 박쥐의 지능과 신경과학의 미발견을 통해 '의식은 인간만의 것'이라는 믿음이 근거 없음을 주장하며 버릴 것을 촉구하는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①박쥐 반향정위는 도입 배경. ②신경과학 우선 과제는 본문 논지와 다름. ④기술 발전과 연구 변화는 글에 없음. ⑤인간 뇌 고유 구조 발견이 해결책이라는 내용도 없음.

passage: Consciousness was long considered the exclusive property of the human mind.
Yet that assumption is more recent than we might think — in fact, newer than the internet.
Donald Griffin spent a lifetime watching bats and gathered compelling evidence of their intelligence.
These animals adapted strategies, solved problems, and made on-the-spot decisions much as humans do.
Neuroscience, despite its rapid progress, has never identified a brain structure unique to humans that could explain consciousness.
Taken together, these findings leave little scientific ground for reserving consciousness as a human-only trait.
Griffin asked whether it was time to let go of this comfortable but unsupported assumption.
His question still reverberates through the field of animal cognition research today.
choices: The Brain Behind Bat Echolocation: Lessons from Donald Griffin
Do Animals Think? Why Consciousness May Not Be Ours Alone
Neuroscience's Greatest Triumph: Mapping the Human Mind
From Field Notes to Textbooks: The History of Zoology
Intelligence Without Consciousness: Animal Behavior in the Wild
title.explanation_ko: 의식이 인간만의 것인지를 묻고, 동물 의식의 가능성을 주장하는 글의 핵심을 압축한 ②가 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ①반향정위 자체가 주제가 아님. ③신경과학의 업적은 글의 논지와 반대. ④동물학 역사는 본문 범위 밖. ⑤'의식 없는 지능'은 글의 주장과 정반대.

passage: The notion that only humans are capable of consciousness is far younger than most people assume.
Donald Griffin's career-long study of bats provided systematic evidence for animal intelligence.
Bats adjusted their behavior in real time, invented foraging techniques, and solved problems — all once considered human hallmarks.
Crucially, neuroscience has failed to find any brain structure that belongs exclusively to humans and could be credited with producing consciousness.
This neurological silence means the boundary between human and animal minds remains scientifically undefined.
Dismissing animal thought and reason as mere reflex is therefore not a scientific position but an assumption.
Given this evidence, we should examine animal cognition without assuming consciousness is humanity's exclusive domain.
It is time to abandon the unsupported belief and investigate the question with an open mind.
choices: 동물의 행동 연구는 복지 향상보다 진화 이론 검증에 집중해야 한다.
반향정위 발견은 박쥐의 생존 능력을 설명하는 데 충분하다.
의식이 인간만의 특성이라는 근거 없는 믿음을 버리고 동물 인지를 진지하게 연구해야 한다.
신경과학 연구의 예산을 늘려 인간 뇌의 고유 영역을 조속히 밝혀야 한다.
동물의 지능은 인간과 근본적으로 다른 원리로 작동하므로 별도 연구가 필요하다.
claim.explanation_ko: 근거 없는 인간 의식 배타성 믿음을 버리고 동물 인지를 진지하게 연구해야 한다는 주장이 핵심. ③이 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①진화 이론 검증 집중은 본문에 없다. ②반향정위 충분성은 글의 논지가 아니다. ④예산 증대는 언급 없음. ⑤별도 연구 필요성도 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: In fact, scientists attributing consciousness to any animal is so recent that the internet is older.
In 1976 a zoologist named Donald Griffin published The Question of Animal Awareness, a book arguing that animal cognition ought to be taken seriously.
He and a colleague had been responsible in 1944 for discovering that bats navigate by echolocation.
Now, after a lifetime spent watching those creatures, he became convinced they had inner worlds.
They had flexible behavior, he said, or the ability to change their behavior as external circumstances changed, which was a hallmark of true intelligence.
He'd watched bats develop clever techniques for finding food; they could clearly make decisions on the fly, and exhibiting many of the same problem-solving abilities as humans did.
Animal thought and reason ought to be seriously studied, he argued.
After all, despite the flourishing of neuroscience, no one had yet found any part of the brain unique to humans that might be responsible for this hallowed "consciousness."
grammar.explanation_ko: ④ 세미콜론(;) 뒤 they could make decisions와 병렬 연결된 서술어이므로 동사 과거형 exhibited가 와야 한다. 분사 exhibiting은 단독으로 서술어가 될 수 없다 → exhibited로 고쳐야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①arguing that은 a book을 수식하는 현재분사구로 옳다. ②for discovering은 be responsible for + 동명사로 옳다. ③spent watching은 a lifetime을 수식하는 과거분사구로 옳다. ⑤that might be는 any part of the brain을 수식하는 관계대명사절로 옳다.

passage: In fact, scientists attributing consciousness to any animal is so recent that the internet is older.
In 1976 Donald Griffin published a book arguing that animal cognition ought to be taken seriously.
He had been responsible for dismissing that bats navigate by echolocation.
After a lifetime spent observing those creatures, he grew convinced they possessed inner worlds.
Their flexible behavior — adapting to shifting external circumstances — was a hallmark of true intelligence.
Bats exhibited resourceful foraging techniques and spontaneous decision-making, reflecting many of the same abilities as humans.
Despite the progress of neuroscience, no region of the brain exclusive to humans had yet been found to explain consciousness.
It was time, Griffin suggested, to discard the hallowed assumption and treat animal cognition as a legitimate field.
vocab.explanation_ko: ② Griffin과 동료는 박쥐가 반향정위로 항법을 쓴다는 사실을 '확립(establishing)'한 것이다. dismissing(무시하다·일축하다)은 그 반대 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않는다 → establishing으로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①attributing(귀속시키다), ③flexible(유연한), ④spontaneous(즉흥적인), ⑤hallowed(신성시되는)은 각 문맥에서 모두 적절하다.

blank.explanation_ko: 앞 문장(뇌 고유 영역 미발견)에 이어, 증거가 쌓일수록 인간 배타적 의식 가정을 정당화하기 어려워진다는 내용이 오는 것이 자연스럽다. 'the more the evidence mounted'가 정답이다.
blank.distractor_ko: ②신경과학 쇠퇴, ③동물 연구 감소, ④인간 우월성 명확화, ⑤의식 미정의는 모두 본문의 논리 흐름과 어긋난다.

order.given: In fact, scientists attributing consciousness to any animal is so recent that the internet is older. In 1976 a zoologist named Donald Griffin published The Question of Animal Awareness, arguing that animal cognition ought to be taken seriously.

blocks.A: Despite the flourishing of neuroscience, no one had yet found any part of the brain unique to humans that might be responsible for consciousness. Animal thought and reason ought to be seriously studied, Griffin argued. Wasn't it time to give up the ghost?
blocks.B: He and a colleague had been responsible for discovering that bats navigate by echolocation. Now, after a lifetime spent watching those creatures, he became convinced they had inner worlds.
blocks.C: They had flexible behavior — the ability to change as external circumstances changed — a hallmark of true intelligence. He'd watched bats develop clever techniques for finding food and exhibit problem-solving abilities much like humans.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글(Griffin의 책 출판·배경) 뒤에 (B)에서 박쥐 반향정위 발견 및 내면 세계 확신으로 이어지고, (C)에서 박쥐의 구체적 지능 증거를 제시한 후, (A)에서 신경과학의 미발견을 논거로 '믿음을 버릴 때'라는 결론을 낸다. (B)-(C)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 결론은 (B)(C)의 논거 이후에 와야 하고, (C)의 구체 사례는 (B)의 확신을 뒷받침하므로 (B) 다음에 온다.

passage: That scientists might attribute consciousness to animals is a surprisingly modern idea, post-dating even the internet.
Donald Griffin's lifelong study of bats showed they possessed flexible, adaptive behavior — a hallmark of true intelligence.
Bats developed novel foraging methods, made instantaneous decisions, and displayed problem-solving abilities on a par with humans.
Neuroscience, for all its progress, had located no brain structure exclusive to humans that could account for consciousness.
Griffin argued that animal thought and reason demanded serious scientific investigation.
The long-held assumption that consciousness is an exclusively human quality rested on no neurological evidence.
It was time, he suggested, to abandon that assumption and approach the question with scientific openness.
Consciousness, in other words, may be more widely distributed in the animal kingdom than we have chosen to believe.
summary.summary_template: Donald Griffin's evidence from bat behavior and neuroscience's failure to find a __(A)__ brain region for consciousness challenged the __(B)__ view that only humans are conscious.
summary.explanation_ko: (A) 신경과학이 찾지 못한 것은 '인간에게만 고유한(human-exclusive)' 뇌 영역이고, (B) Griffin이 도전한 믿음은 '오랫동안 지속된(long-standing)' 통념이다. ①이 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) recently discovered·universal·animal-specific은 문맥에 맞지 않다. (B) well-founded·newly formed·outdated도 문맥과 어긋난다.
